located_point.method: Centre of the bare, roughly round mound about 220 m across in the Sentinel-2 median composite (UTM 43N E 537960 N 3274365), 1.0 km south-west of the modern village; the Wikidata starting point lies inside the mound. The fortified area on the plans (about 300 by 280 m) extends beyond the bare mound into fields.

sources.result: No line measured. The mound shows a curved brighter rim on its north and west, consistent in form with the curved acropolis wall of the plans, but no straight feature; the straight outer fortification of the plans lies under fields and shows no trace at 10 m. A straight north-south bright line east of the mound (E 538105) is a modern track.

notes: Imagery: not measurable at 10 m. Plans: one drawing of the outer fortification, printed twice with different north symbols, was measured as two sources. The outer enclosure is an irregular quadrilateral: its southern wall and the southern stretch of its western wall lie within 1 degree of the plan arrows (theta 0.2 and 0.3 on Puratattva 29, 0.9 and 0.7 on IAR 1987-88), its northern wall and the northern stretch of the western wall at +8.8 to +11.9, and its eastern wall at -9.7 to -12.3. The rule's main system on both prints is sw-walls (south and south-west walls). The street running south from the northern gate bastion lies at +2.7 (Puratattva) and +3.9 (IAR) and is more than 200 m from the south-west walls, so it stands alone. The two prints' arrows differ by 0.85 degrees relative to the same drawn walls, which measures the drafting difference between the two north symbols. The enclosure has no single dominant direction: the north and east walls diverge from the south-west walls by about 10 degrees each in opposite senses. The curved acropolis wall was not measured.
plan_search: Plan library entry banawali-01 (Puratattva 29) and the held IAR 1987-88 (Fig. 1, plus sections Figs. 2-3, not plans). No other Banawali plan found in held IAR volumes 1976-77, 1982-83, 1999-2000.
stated_orientation_encounters: IAR 1987-88 Fig. 2 (PDF p. 32), a section across the defences in trench TrC2, is labelled 'NNE' and 'SSW' at its ends; this compass-point label of a section line was not used.
